title: Prohibition on Inclination towards the Wrongdoers
data:
In Surah Hud, Almighty Allah says:
وَلَاتَرْكَنُوْا اِلَى الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَ مَالَكُمْ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ اَوْلِيَاۤءَ ثُمَّ لَاتُنْصَرُوْنَ.
WALAATARKANUWA AILAAA ALADHIYNA ZALAMUWA FATAMASAKUMU ALNAARU WA MAALAKUM MIN DUWNI I MIN AAWLIYAA'A THUMA LAATUNSARUWNA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
